card.text: Young Sun-like star 27 parsecs away in Lepus, with a Jupiter-like planet photographed directly.

introduction.text: AF Lep is a young star in the beta Pictoris moving group, 24 million years old. Its pull on the star led astronomers to its planet b in 2023.

sources.label: Franson et al. 2023
sources.quote: stars with astrometric accelerations between Hipparcos and Gaia

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.

radial-field-2007-12.title: Radial field, Dec 2007
radial-field-2007-12.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.

brightness-sector-32.title: Brightness map, Sector 32
brightness-sector-32.summary: Darker and brighter longitudes of the star, worked out in this project from how its light changes as it turns.

color-brightness.title: Color + brightness, Nov to Dec 2020
color-brightness.summary: The star in its own color, darker where its light shows it darker; the contrast is drawn stronger to be seen.
